base_prompt: Create ONE Bug Archive mascot matching supplied first-episode STYLE REFERENCES. Polished smooth 2D chibi anime, fluorescent yellow-lime rounded bug, two long antennae with round bulbs, huge black oval glossy eyes, pink cheeks, tiny feet, fine dark outline and upper-left white gloss. Full character and props centered with ample transparent margin. One large readable visual gag integrated into shell/body/accessories, clear at thumbnail size. Genuine transparent PNG. No text, letters, numbers, labels, background, card, ground, cast shadow or watermark. Error metaphor:

episodes.concept: Constraint clause specified twice: bug has two identical rule scroll-shaped belts both trying to buckle into the single same waist clasp; blank scrolls with same pictorial star seal.

Class or struct constraint must come first: bug pulling its large basic shell plate from behind a row of tiny accessory clasps that obstruct installation; empty shell-shaped first mounting frame on belly.
Cannot combine base class and class/struct constraints: bug squeezed by incompatible double armor, soft chain-mail outer jacket and rigid gemstone inner block, both claiming same large central clasp.
Struct and new constraint incompatible: bug with a naturally self-hatching gem egg shell carrying an unnecessary second crank starter that tangles against the already built-in starter.

Circular constraint dependency: a round lime bug whose TWO antennae curl toward each other and are interlocked into ONE closed infinity loop above its head. A gold padlock and a silver padlock are interlinked at center of loop; each prevents the other from opening. The bug pulls both ends helplessly with tiny hands. Make circular self-dependency visually obvious, no loose unrelated locks, no text.
Conflicting inherited value/reference constraints: bug's split shell has one rigid solid cube half and one hollow chain-link half, halves unable to join down central seam.
Struct-constrained parameter cannot be another constraint: bug tries using a solid sealed gem as a flexible fitting stencil around a smaller token, but solid gem has no hole and blocks it.
Method and interface constraints must match: bug holds star-shaped badge connector against square-shaped contract harness socket; clear matching placement but wrong shape.
Override inherits constraints: bug wears a parent-shell harness with fixed star clasp and tries bolting a contradictory square clasp over it; original clasp clearly still governs fit.
Cannot derive from type parameter: bug tries to build sturdy shell on top of an unstable mystery-shaped jelly foundation changing between circle and square silhouettes.
